texts.text: NESTLÉ PAKISTAN LIMITED DIRECTORS' REVIEW

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The Directors of Nestlé Pakistan Limited (the "Company") are pleased to submit the director's report, along with the condensed interim financial statements of the Company for the nine months period ended September 30, 2026.
texts.text: The Directors of Nestlé Pakistan Limited (the "Company") are pleased to submit the director's report, along with the condensed interim financial statements of the Company for the nine months period ended September 30, 2026.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Business Performance Review:
texts.text: Business Performance Review:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Net sales for the nine-month period ended September 30, 2026, amounted to PKR 160 billion, representing an increase of 6.3% compared to the same period of the prior year. Despite the challenging geopolitical and business operating environment marked by rising inflation, political instability and a sharp escalation in fuel and energy prices driven by the US-Iran war, the Company successfully sustained business momentum. This resilience was underpinned by increased investment behind our brands, consumer-centric innovation and renovation (I&R), focused marketplace execution, strengthened export routes to market, and disciplined pricing actions, where necessary.
texts.text: Net sales for the nine-month period ended September 30, 2026, amounted to PKR 160 billion, representing an increase of 6.3% compared to the same period of the prior year. Despite the challenging geopolitical and business operating environment marked by rising inflation, political instability and a sharp escalation in fuel and energy prices driven by the US-Iran war, the Company successfully sustained business momentum. This resilience was underpinned by increased investment behind our brands, consumer-centric innovation and renovation (I&R), focused marketplace execution, strengthened export routes to market, and disciplined pricing actions, where necessary.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Our continued focused investment in green energy initiatives, especially in the areas of solar and biomass, has helped us in partially offsetting the energy cost headwinds while reducing carbon emissions. An improved topline, disciplined overhead management, and continuous focus on value chain optimization initiatives have resulted in an increase of 8.1% in gross profit as compared to the same period of the prior year. However, at the operating profit level, this improvement was reduced to 5.9% mainly due to increased investment behind our brands and higher distribution costs, driven by fuel prices.

However, at the operating profit level, this improvement was reduced to 5.9% mainly due to increased investment behind our brands and higher distribution costs, driven by fuel prices.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Net profit after tax improved by 3.1% as compared to the same period of the prior year, despite the impact of higher taxation expense.

texts.orig: Future Outlook:
texts.text: Future Outlook:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Due to on-going geopolitical instability, continued volatility in energy and other input costs, and elevated inflation driven by fuel prices, the Company maintains a cautious outlook for the full year 2026. While inflationary pressures may continue to influence consumer spending and operating costs, the Company is well positioned to navigate these challenges by ensuring appropriate investment behind its brands to strengthen its market leadership position in key product categories, focusing on achieving operational excellence, developing future ready high performing teams and advancing on its sustainability agenda to serve as a force for good.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: 16.1 On 23 July 2026, Nestlé S.A. announced a proposed 50:50 joint venture with Platinum Equity covering its waters and premium beverages business, including the Pakistan operations. The transaction remains subject to definitive agreements and corporate and regulatory approvals. As a next step, Nestlé Pakistan Limited has incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, Waters and Premium Beverages PK (Private) Limited on 28 July 2026.

The transaction remains subject to definitive agreements and corporate and regulatory approvals. As a next step, Nestlé Pakistan Limited has incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary, Waters and Premium Beverages PK (Private) Limited on 28 July 2026.

Accordingly, the Subsidiary has not been consolidated, and its financial highlights are not presented.
